machineReceipt: executor JSON retains available model, operation, task identity, requested count, safe parameters, command and progress; do not rename or reconstruct these fields

submission.nextAction: Briefly state that the task was accepted; then wait only for this task.

continuation.nextAction: Report only a meaningful status change or the need for explicit continuation.

reconciliation.nextAction: Explain that verification is required; retain this task and do not infer a refund or submit a replacement.

completion.nextAction: Provide the actual attachment and note missing indexes if any; do not repeat the entire task receipt.

conditionalFields.task_id: Retain a known task ID; never invent one.
conditionalFields.failure_phase: Explain the phase when it changes the next action.
conditionalFields.http_status: Only when returned and useful; otherwise omit.
conditionalFields.api_error_code: Only the exact returned public code; otherwise omit.

failure.nextAction: State what failed and the next safe action; unknown submission never authorizes automatic repetition.
